result.description:
WELDWORKS PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Carpenter for our client's construction industry (residential
homes, commercial buildings, and public spaces) across NSW, WA in Australia. On a full-time basis, you will be part of a
multidisciplinary and well-supported team.

Title: Carpenter, Full-time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person.

We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:
Requirements

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience
• Certificate III in Carpentry or equivalent
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality workmanship
• Valid driver’s license and own transport (preferred)
• Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings.
• Physical stamina and strength.
• Attention to detail and precision.
• Good communication and teamwork skills.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities.

Responsibilities
• Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering plans to precisely measure, cut, and assemble
materials.
• Construct, install, and repair structures such as walls, floors, ceilings, stairs, door frames, windows, cabinets, and
other wooden fixtures.
• Ensure all work complies with building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards.
• Operate hand tools, power tools, and heavy machinery safely and efficiently.
• Estimate materials, labor, and costs needed for carpentry projects and prepare detailed work plans.
• Collaborate with architects, contractors, and clients to ensure the project specifications are met.
• Supervise and coordinate with junior carpenters and other workers on the job site.
• Inspect completed work for quality and accuracy before final installation or handover.
• Maintain a clean and safe work environment during and after the project completion.
• Troubleshoot and solve on-site problems quickly to keep projects on schedule.

If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to date CV. We can schedule in
a time to discuss the positions available and what will be best suited to you.

The Benedict Industries group of companies is a Sydney-based, family-owned and managed Quarrying, Resources and Recycling Company.

In 1978 the Company expanded into mining, acquiring a large sand resource at Chipping Norton (which it extracted until 1999) before embarking on a course of expanding its resource base that continues today. The Company continues to acquire and develop new deposits for extraction throughout the Sydney region and supplies a comprehensive range of Sands, Soils, Sandstone, Decorative Aggregates and Recycled products.

Benedict Industries is looking for MAINTENANCE FITTER to join their team of professionals on a full time and permanent basis.

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Minimum 3yrs experience as a qualified Welder/ Boilermaker/ Fitter.
Ability to work in a high pressured, high paced environment.
Competent and working alone and as part of a team.
Ability to interpret plans & designs.
Awareness of working environment with heavy plant machinery.
Good eye for detail.
Ability to work in a confined area.

Your key accountabilities include, but are not necessarily limited to:
Steel fabrication & welding of new & replacement parts
Scheduled maintenance of Plant, Crushing Plant and Timber Shredder
Scheduling servicing of Plant, Crushing Plant and Timber Shredder.

Team input to improve current plant design and assist with re-engineering and installation
Gas Cutting
Gas Welding
Arc Welding
Mig Welding
Some confined space/ restricted access work as directed.
To operate plant and equipment from time to time as required

You are required to adhere to, and take responsibility for, all company policies including, but not limited to,
Occupational Health & Safety policy
Environment policy
Vehicle policy
Computer policy
Confidentiality Policy
Quality
General housekeeping and sweeping as required
Attend and participate in any management, leadership, safety course and any other course relevant to your job description as suggested by your manager
To maintain Company Property, including vehicle, mobile phone and Laptop

If you possess the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!

Seven Corp on behalf of SHR Joinery


Overview: 

SHR Joinery is a leading Sydney-based joinery company specialising in the design, manufacture, and installation of bespoke architectural joinery for residential, commercial, and public infrastructure projects. Operating from our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility, we deliver high-quality, custom joinery solutions with a strong focus on craftsmanship, innovation, and attention to detail. From concept through to installation, we are committed to exceeding client expectations by providing exceptional workmanship, reliable service, and tailored solutions for projects of every scale.

We are currently seeking a Carpenter and Joiner to join the team! your role will be responsible for the manufacture, assembly, installation and finishing of custom joinery products across both factory and site environments. This is a full-time ongoing position, working 38 hours per week based in Yennora, NSW.

Main tasks:

Factory / Workshop Responsibilities – 

-	Cabinet and joinery assembly 
-	Cutting, machining and preparation of materials 
-	Operation of woodworking machinery and equipment including but not limited to: 
o	CNC machinery 
o	Panel saw 
o	Edge bander 
o	Table saw 
o	Hand and power tools 
-	Reading and interpreting production drawings and technical documentation 
-	Edge finishing and detailed joinery work 
-	Adhesive application and material preparation 
-	Quality control and inspection of completed work 
-	Maintaining workshop cleanliness and housekeeping standards 
-	Assisting with loading, unloading and material handling as required 
-	Studying and interpreting drawings and specifications to determine materials and installation methods
-	Cutting, shaping and fitting timber components
-	Constructing timber structures and bespoke timber fittings

Site Installation Responsibilities 

-	Installation of custom joinery and cabinetry on site 
-	Interpretation of shop drawings and site plans 
-	Site measurement and verification where required 
-	Use of hand and power tools during installation works 
-	Coordination with supervisors, builders and other trades on site 
-	Rectification and adjustment of joinery items where required 
-	Protection of completed works and maintaining site presentation 
-	Compliance with site induction and safety requirements 
-	Reporting site issues, defects or variations to management
-	Installation of timber structures, door and window frames and timber fittings
-	Repair and modification of existing timber fittings where required

Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum of relevant Certificate IV plus minimum 1 year’ relevant work experience in the last 5 years.
-	3 years’ relevant work experience may substitute the formal qualification.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Experience in carpentry or joinery 
-	Ability to read and interpret drawings and specifications 
-	Experience using woodworking machinery and power tools 
-	Strong workmanship and attention to detail 
-	Ability to work independently and within a team 
-	Good communication and problem-solving skills 
-	Construction White Card (preferred/required) 
-	Driver licence (preferred)


Annual salary will be between $95,000.00 to $105,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent
